checks.description: Verified manifest.json SHA-256 against the assigned submission identity, all nine asset hashes, and the empty candidate.diff digest. Manifest records no changed paths or candidate revision.

Inspected CM-SAVED-A1's scoped claim and CM-E1 provenance: recorded probe.py/audit.py commands, input hashes, settings, fit revision 72523b9dc64155bf58fc1b8f0ea7241266ff73d4 and evaluation revision 5400cefc0238007406f5cd572d21ef5a72d2958d. Comparisons concern final applied consensus geometry using summed per-anchor distances, separately from single-fit diagnostics.

Read-only structural, arithmetic and set checks passed: eight additional names contain one improvement, two regressions and five unchanged outcomes; stored errors sum to 401.10027562823973 versus 400.7970309548157 mm. Regressions are +0.5029977549565103 and +0.09415630167794076 mm.

Confirmed saved training-set unions leave no common unseen fold for changed rows 6, 9 and 10; each variant-only unseen terminal sweep trained a baseline member. Applied spool payloads match between arms, and eight unchanged anchor/spool payloads are identical. Inspected the standard-library extractor and its 91 recorded passing checks; performed no selection, prediction, fitting, geometry-error or physics replay.

limitations: Numerical measurements remain historical producer evidence. Raw envelopes, producer scripts and numerical implementation were outside the selected evidence; hashes and internal agreement do not establish numerical correctness.

Twenty source files reportedly changed between fit production and evaluation. Recorded single-fit diagnostic agreement supports limited compatibility, not complete ranking, fresh-fit or current-code equivalence.

Changed selections lack common unseen prediction evidence. Dataset names and distinct recorded hashes do not establish independent physical worlds; hp3-named inputs retain the manifest's hangprinter_4 labels.
No stopping-trajectory, hardware or broader model-adequacy conclusion follows from this archived final-selection comparison.
